name: Rystic
long_description:
Staging environments and test sandboxes don't scale for development with AI.

Instead we give every change a deterministic simulated environment populated with local, stateful simulators of APIs like Slack, Stripe, GitHub, and PostHog. Control everything about your dependencies, from the clock to injected faults, and use our harness for integration tests or agent evals.

With simulation testing, every change is evaluated quickly in its own private world where you can measure its impact on other systems. We're building the next step forward in software testing, one that scales with your agents instead of holding them back.
one_liner: Test agents and code changes in high-fidelity simulated environments
